_doc: Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 NPU (Hexagon, weight-stall 32x32 systolic arrays) spec for SoC profile sd8gen3_cim (ADR-0008). EVERY number is BORROWED from HeteroInfer (SOSP'25; cim-mobile-soc/docs/heteroinfer-design-reference.md §2.2, §3b Table 3): `anchors` are Table 3 NPU latencies (weight [N_out,K_in], activation [K_in,M]); `anchor_fit` is our staircase-roofline reproduction (tools/analysis/fit_hetero_anchors.py; model = NpuStaircaseModel in simulator/models/m4_npu.py). NO silicon of ours. The RKNPU2 fields (tops_int8, bw_GBs, dtypes, systolic_dim) are carried because NpuStaircaseModel subclasses the analytic NpuModel; the staircase model reads anchor_fit, not tops_int8/bw_GBs.
honesty: borrowed (HeteroInfer published Table 3/Fig.3/Fig.4 numbers; fitted, no silicon of ours)

notes.staircase: Fig.3: latency steps every 32 activation rows (one systolic tile); any M <= 32 costs the same.
notes.k_penalty: NPU-3: a large contraction dim (K_in=14336) costs ~4x more per weight than K_in=4096 at equal N_out*K_in; modelled as (K/k_ref)^k_penalty_exp on both the weight-load and the streamed term.
notes.order: Fig.4: reversing the operand order (activation stationary) costs up to 6x -> wl.extra['order']='activation_stationary' multiplies by order_penalty_max.
notes.4096x4096_triple: the M=1/128/256 anchors (693/912/1884) are mutually inconsistent with a linear-in-steps law; minimax spreads the error to ~14% on each.
notes.weights: weight_bytes_per_param=1 (effective; decode uses INT per §5.1 fn.1, prefill W4A16->FP16 — the fit cannot separate them).
notes.fig3_check: the fitted model reproduces the Fig.3 levels for [4096,14336] at steps 1..6 within -7%..+5% (see anchor_fit.json).

provenance.tflops_fp16_estimated: HeteroInfer Tab.2 authors' estimate (half of INT8) [borrowed]
provenance.bw_GBs: HeteroInfer §3.3 Fig.5 per-unit 40-45 GB/s of a 68 peak [borrowed]
provenance.anchor_fit: minimax relative-error fit of the anchors (fit_hetero_anchors.py) [borrowed, fitted]
provenance.cores: single logical NPU (the paper never splits it) [assumption]

anchor_fit._doc: 32-row staircase minimax fit of `anchors` (fit_hetero_anchors.py): floor + (K/k_ref)^p * (K*N/bw + ceil(M/32)*2*32*K*N/tops_eff). [borrowed, fitted]
